[[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated's]] '''327 core''' was the core [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]], and also included connections to the ship's [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]].
